Turnover of interaction partners in a simulated metacommunity

Source: R/traits_rates.R
partner_turnover.Rd

Counts, for each species, how often the composition around it changes: the number of other species that enter or leave the sites where the species is present, between successive recorded steps of simulate_metacommunity(). The count is divided by the number of sites and time steps over which the species was present at both ends of an interval, so it is a rate of change of partners per site and per time step. It measures the entries and exits of partners of scenario 5 of the notes on branch rates, and feeds turnover_rates().

Usage

partner_turnover(x, partners = c("all", "competitors"))

Arguments

x

An mc_sim object with history, that is, run with record_steps.

partners

"all" counts every other species as a partner; "competitors" counts only the species with a non-zero competition coefficient with the focal species in x$alpha (in either direction).

Value

Named numeric vector, one value per species. Species never present at two successive recorded steps get zero.

See also

turnover_rates(), history_rates()

Other species traits: arrival_ages(), as_herodotools(), food_web_rates(), history_rates(), paint_regimes(), plot.rate_matrix(), plot_rates(), plot_traits(), rate_matrix(), region_pool(), species_traits(), tip_history_metrics(), trait_bm(), trait_mk(), trait_rates(), traits_ou(), turnover_rates()

Examples

set.seed(1)
tr <- treeshapesim::sim_tree_shape(10)
sim <- simulate_metacommunity(landscape_implicit(15), species_traits(tr),
                              competition_matrix(tr, "none"), n_steps = 300,
                              record_steps = seq(100, 300, 20), extirpation = 0.02)
partner_turnover(sim)
#>         t1         t2         t3         t4         t5         t6         t7 
#> 0.05564516 0.08333333 0.05588235 0.09000000 0.04500000 0.07142857 0.00000000 
#>         t8         t9        t10 
#> 0.00000000 0.06093750 0.06106870
